correctness.rationale: A_n=Ind_2(C_n) rim classification from graph distances and mapping cone on the rim polygon is exact. For n>=6, every omitted triangle has an explicit 3-triangle cone to vertex i+4; complete-graph loop generation proves pi1(A_n)=0 and hence a null rim attachment. Deshpande–Singh Theorem 4.6 supplies all n>=6 circle cycle terms. The n=5 rim complex is a triangulated Möbius band, so closing its boundary cone yields RP2; n=4 graph and n=3 simplex follow. Actual extracted verifier reproduces n<=16 instances, surface links and SNF torsion; experiments are not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural infinite-family topology classification, with a genuine integral torsion exception at the smallest pentagonal rim and an explicit all-order vanishing attaching loop. The projective-plane occurrence and sharp change to four-periodic sphere wedges are not consequences of ordinary general-position cardinalities or face enumeration alone.
